_comment: Usage notes for tokens.json. build.mjs refuses to run if base.css declares a token with no entry here: add the note, then rebuild.

palette.paper-0: Palette (layer 1). White; behind `surface-card` in light. Never reference from a component.
palette.paper-50: Palette (layer 1). Warm off-white; behind `surface` in light. Never reference from a component.
palette.sand-200: Palette (layer 1). Warm hairline; behind `border` in light.
palette.ink-900: Palette (layer 1). Near-black warm ink; behind `fg` in light.
palette.ink-500: Palette (layer 1). Warm grey ink; behind `fg-muted` in light.
palette.teal-700: Palette (layer 1). Behind `accent` in light; also the default (teal) ring on a light canvas.
palette.teal-300: Palette (layer 1). Behind `accent` in dark; the default ring on a dark canvas. Chroma 0.091: the ceiling every other color stays under.
palette.navy-900: Palette (layer 1). Deep navy-slate; behind `surface` in dark.

semantic.surface: Page ground. The only page background.
semantic.surface-card: Raised panel: cards, and the ground for info messages (there is no --info).
semantic.fg-muted: Secondary text on `surface` and `surface-card`; still clears AA.
semantic.accent: Interactive: links, buttons, the one eyebrow. Text on `surface` and `surface-card`.
semantic.border: Hairlines and edges. Also the meta rule on fixed canvases, so teal appears once.

spacing.space-2xs: Heading to its own paragraph; tight pairs.
spacing.space-m: Card padding; gap after a header block.

layout.page: Max width of a full-width layout.

fontWeight.fw-display: Default heading weight for `--font-display`. Use `var(--fw-display)`, never a literal.
